"""Prose that names the package: :class:`threetears.evals.ops.OpsHost` and
:func:`~threetears.evals.run.definition_drift.drift_kinds`, served from ``threetears.evals.schema``."""

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class Section(BaseModel):
    lease: float = Field(description="Seconds; the package's threetears.evals.schema.DEFAULT_JOB_LEASE_S by default.")
    """Mirrors ``threetears.evals.schema.DEFAULT_JOB_LEASE_S``, so the import costs nothing."""

    # The kinds come from threetears.evals.kernel.JUDGE_KIND; see threetears.evals.kernel.host.profile.


def check(value: float) -> None:
    assert value > 0, f"see threetears.evals.analysis.CampaignReport for {value}"
